trans-unit.target: Kikomo cha kasi dhidi ya kunakili

trans-unit.source: Log only: record what it would stop
trans-unit.target: Rekodi tu: andika kile ambacho kingezuiwa
Kurasa kwa dakika, kwa kila anwani
Kurasa kwa dakika, kwa kila mtandao

trans-unit.source: A /24 network for IPv4 or a /64 for IPv6: what a scraper gets when it rotates addresses next to each other.
trans-unit.target: Mtandao wa /24 kwa IPv4 au /64 kwa IPv6: kile anachopata mvunaji anapozungusha anwani zilizo jirani.
Kiotomatiki: majaribio %d ya roboti ndani ya saa 24

trans-unit.source: [%s] Someone asks you to review a firewall block
trans-unit.target: [%s] Mtu anakuomba ukague kizuizi cha ngome

trans-unit.source: The registration could not be completed.

trans-unit.target: Majaribio ya hivi karibuni ya kutiliwa shaka

trans-unit.source: Kept for 90 days. Never passwords. The CSV of an address holds everything it did, ready to attach to an abuse report to its network provider.
trans-unit.target: Huhifadhiwa siku 90. Kamwe si nywila. CSV ya anwani ina kila kitu ilichofanya, tayari kuambatishwa kwenye ripoti ya matumizi mabaya kwa mtoa huduma wake wa mtandao.

trans-unit.source: Only connections from these addresses may set the visitor address through a header. One address or range per line. Empty: this server and private networks. Cloudflare's own ranges are already known.
trans-unit.target: Ni miunganisho kutoka anwani hizi tu inayoweza kuweka anwani ya mgeni kupitia kichwa. Anwani au safu moja kwa kila mstari. Tupu: seva hii na mitandao binafsi. Safu za Cloudflare zenyewe tayari zinajulikana.

trans-unit.source: Logging in, signing up and forms (recommended)
Countries (two-letter codes, e.g. ES, FR, DE)
trans-unit.target: Nchi (misimbo ya herufi mbili, mf. ES, FR, DE)

trans-unit.source: IP geolocation by DB-IP (db-ip.com, CC BY 4.0), downloaded when you switch the filter on and looked up on your own server: no address is sent anywhere.
trans-unit.target: Mahali pa IP kutoka DB-IP (db-ip.com, CC BY 4.0), hupakuliwa unapowasha kichujio na kuangaliwa kwenye seva yako mwenyewe: hakuna anwani inayotumwa popote.

trans-unit.source: The country list could not be downloaded. The filter does nothing until it is there; save again later.
trans-unit.target: Orodha ya nchi haikuweza kupakuliwa. Kichujio hakifanyi chochote hadi orodha iwepo; hifadhi tena baadaye.

trans-unit.source: Refuse passwords found in data breaches
trans-unit.target: Kataa nywila zilizopatikana katika uvujaji wa data

trans-unit.source: The password must have at least %d characters.
trans-unit.target: Nenosiri lazima liwe na angalau herufi %d.

trans-unit.source: This password appears in known data breaches, so attackers try it first. Please choose another one.
trans-unit.target: Nenosiri hili linaonekana katika uvujaji wa data unaojulikana, kwa hivyo washambulizi hulijaribu kwanza. Tafadhali chagua jingine.

trans-unit.source: It could not be done for that address.
People the firewall stopped can ask from the block page. Let them through for a while if it was a mistake. Draco never writes to them: answer from your own mail if you want.
trans-unit.target: Watu waliozuiwa na ngome wanaweza kuomba kutoka kwenye ukurasa wa kizuizi. Waruhusu kupita kwa muda ikiwa lilikuwa kosa. Draco haiwaandikii kamwe: jibu kutoka kwa barua pepe yako mwenyewe ukipenda.

trans-unit.source: Works: a database injection was recognised and blocked (403).
trans-unit.target: Inafanya kazi: uingizaji kwenye hifadhidata umetambuliwa na kuzuiwa (403).

trans-unit.source: The test attack was not recognised. Please report it to Draco Insomnis.
trans-unit.target: Shambulio la jaribio halikutambuliwa. Tafadhali iarifu Draco Insomnis.

trans-unit.source: The firewall is off: switch it on and save, then test again.
trans-unit.target: Ngome imezimwa: iwashe, hifadhi, kisha jaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: Works: a database injection was recognised. In "Log only" it is written down but not stopped; switch to "Block" when you are ready.
trans-unit.target: Inafanya kazi: uingizaji kwenye hifadhidata umetambuliwa. Katika "Rekodi tu" unaandikwa lakini hauzuiwi; hamia "Zuia" ukiwa tayari.

trans-unit.source: Stops fake customer sign-ups without captchas, firewall and anti-copy limits. Open source.
trans-unit.target: Huzuia usajili bandia wa wateja bila captcha, ngome ya mtandao na vikomo dhidi ya kunakili. Chanzo huria.

trans-unit.source: Stops fake customer sign-ups without captchas: bots get no account, and every suspicious attempt is kept for 90 days as evidence for an abuse report. Nothing is ever sent back to the attacker.
trans-unit.target: Huzuia usajili bandia wa wateja bila captcha: roboti hazipati akaunti, na kila jaribio la kutiliwa shaka huhifadhiwa siku 90 kama ushahidi wa ripoti ya matumizi mabaya. Hakuna kinachorudishwa kwa mshambuliaji.

trans-unit.source: Your address as the module sees it:
If the shop is behind Cloudflare or another proxy and these differ from your real address, choose the matching option in "Visitor address".
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa duka liko nyuma ya Cloudflare au proksi nyingine na hizi zinatofautiana na anwani yako halisi, chagua chaguo linalofaa katika “Anwani ya mgeni”.

trans-unit.source: Adds an invisible trap and a signed page stamp to the sign-up form (account page and checkout). Bots get no account; three bot attempts in a day block the address for a week.
trans-unit.target: Huongeza mtego usioonekana na muhuri wa ukurasa uliotiwa saini kwenye fomu ya usajili (ukurasa wa akaunti na malipo). Roboti hazipati akaunti; majaribio matatu ya roboti kwa siku moja huzuia anwani kwa wiki moja.

trans-unit.source: Stops requests with the shape of an attack (database injection, reading server files, running code, scripts in links) and scanners such as sqlmap or Nikto. Start with "Log only" and move to "Block" after a few days. Five attacks in 10 minutes block the address for a week; blocked addresses can still browse, but not post. Emergency exit: define('DRACO_WAF_OFF', true); in config/defines_custom.inc.php.
trans-unit.target: Huzuia maombi yenye umbo la shambulio (kudunga hifadhidata, kusoma faili za seva, kuendesha msimbo, hati katika viungo) na vichanganuzi kama sqlmap au Nikto. Anza na “Rekodi tu” kisha badilisha kuwa “Zuia” baada ya siku chache. Mashambulio matano ndani ya dakika 10 huzuia anwani kwa wiki moja; anwani zilizozuiwa bado zinaweza kuvinjari, lakini haziwezi kutuma. Njia ya dharura: define('DRACO_WAF_OFF', true); katika config/defines_custom.inc.php.

trans-unit.source: More pages per minute than a person reads get "429 Too many requests" until the minute ends. Logged-in customers, your own addresses and search engines verified by DNS (Google, Bing, Apple, Yandex) are never limited.
trans-unit.target: Anayeomba kurasa nyingi kwa dakika kuliko anavyosoma mtu hupata “429 Too many requests” hadi dakika iishe. Wateja walioingia, anwani zako mwenyewe na injini za utafutaji zilizothibitishwa kwa DNS (Google, Bing, Apple, Yandex) hawawekewi kikomo kamwe.

trans-unit.source: Leave "Connection address" unless the shop is behind a proxy: a header can be forged by anyone.
trans-unit.target: Acha “Anwani ya muunganisho” isipokuwa duka liko nyuma ya proksi: kichwa kinaweza kughushiwa na yeyote.

trans-unit.source: One range per line (CIDR), added to the ones the module already knows. Being on this list only adds points: on its own it never makes anyone a bot.
trans-unit.target: Safu moja kwa kila mstari (CIDR), inayoongezwa kwa zile moduli inazozijua tayari. Kuwa kwenye orodha hii huongeza alama tu: peke yake haimfanyi mtu yeyote kuwa roboti.

trans-unit.source: This request was stopped for security reasons. If you think this is a mistake, contact the owner of the shop.
trans-unit.target: Ombi hili limezuiwa kwa sababu za usalama. Ikiwa unadhani ni kosa, wasiliana na mmiliki wa duka.

trans-unit.source: The header is ignored: this connection (%s) does not come from Cloudflare or from a trusted proxy. If your proxy is on the internet, add its addresses in "Trusted proxies".
trans-unit.target: Kichwa kinapuuzwa: muunganisho huu (%s) haukutoka Cloudflare wala kwa proksi inayoaminika. Ikiwa proksi yako iko kwenye intaneti, ongeza anwani zake katika “Proksi zinazoaminika”.

trans-unit.source: Nothing was blocked: the value is not valid, belongs to an employee, or is your own address.
trans-unit.target: Hakuna kilichozuiwa: thamani si sahihi, ni ya mfanyakazi, au ni anwani yako mwenyewe.

trans-unit.source: Most of your customers may come from many countries, and an attacker changes country with a VPN. Filter only logging in, signing up and forms, and start with "Log only". Employees, people you let through and search engines are never filtered. Needs the firewall on (log or block).
trans-unit.target: Wateja wako wanaweza kutoka nchi nyingi, na mshambuliaji hubadilisha nchi kwa VPN. Chuja kuingia, usajili na fomu tu, na uanze na “Rekodi tu”. Wafanyakazi, watu unaowaruhusu kupita na injini za utafutaji hawachujwi kamwe. Inahitaji ngome ya mtandao iwashwe (rekodi au zuia).

trans-unit.source: On shop pages: no sniffing of file types, no framing by other sites, less referrer data, no camera, microphone or location for embedded content. Never one already sent.
trans-unit.target: Kwenye kurasa za duka: hakuna kukisia aina za faili, hakuna kupachikwa ndani ya tovuti nyingine, data ndogo ya kirejeleo, hakuna kamera, maikrofoni wala mahali kwa maudhui yaliyopachikwa. Kamwe kichwa ambacho tayari kimetumwa.

trans-unit.source: Only when the whole shop works on HTTPS and will keep working: browsers remember it and refuse plain HTTP until it expires.
trans-unit.target: Tu ikiwa duka zima linafanya kazi kwa HTTPS na litaendelea hivyo: vivinjari hukumbuka hilo na hukataa HTTP ya kawaida hadi muda uishe.

trans-unit.source: Never an employee, nor your own address. Ranges no wider than /16 (IPv4) or /32 (IPv6).
trans-unit.target: Kamwe si mfanyakazi, wala anwani yako mwenyewe. Safu zisizo pana kuliko /16 (IPv4) au /32 (IPv6).

trans-unit.source: A visitor stopped by the firewall asks for a review. Open the Draco Insomnis module to let them through or not.
trans-unit.target: Mgeni aliyezuiwa na ngome ya mtandao anaomba ukaguzi. Fungua moduli ya Draco Insomnis ili umruhusu kupita au la.

trans-unit.source: Thank you. The owner of the shop will look at it and, if it was a mistake, let you through.
trans-unit.target: Asante. Mmiliki wa duka ataliangalia na, ikiwa lilikuwa kosa, atakuruhusu kupita.

trans-unit.source: This request was stopped for security reasons. If you think this is a mistake, tell the owner of the shop what you were doing:
trans-unit.target: Ombi hili limezuiwa kwa sababu za usalama. Ikiwa unadhani ni kosa, mweleze mmiliki wa duka ulichokuwa ukifanya:

trans-unit.source: The test could not reach the shop from the server itself (some hostings do not allow it). The firewall may still work: look at the last attempts.
trans-unit.target: Jaribio halikuweza kufikia duka kutoka kwenye seva yenyewe (baadhi ya wahudumu wa tovuti hawaruhusu hilo). Ngome ya mtandao bado inaweza kuwa inafanya kazi: angalia majaribio ya hivi karibuni.

trans-unit.source: The test was stopped before it reached PrestaShop, by the hosting's own firewall. Good: two layers.
trans-unit.target: Jaribio lilizuiwa kabla ya kufika PrestaShop, na ngome ya mtandao ya mhudumu wa tovuti mwenyewe. Vizuri: tabaka mbili.

trans-unit.source: Sends a harmless attack-shaped request to the shop and tells you what happened. It is not logged.
trans-unit.target: Hutuma kwa duka ombi lisilo na madhara lenye umbo la shambulio na kukueleza kilichotokea. Halirekodiwi.

trans-unit.source: From 8 to 64 characters; 0 leaves only the shop's own rules. Applied when a customer creates an account or changes the password.
trans-unit.target: Herufi 8 hadi 64; 0 huacha sheria za duka lenyewe pekee. Hutumika mteja anapounda akaunti au kubadilisha nywila.

trans-unit.source: Asks Have I Been Pwned with k-anonymity: only 5 characters of the password's SHA-1 leave the shop, never the password. If the service does not answer in 3 seconds, the password is accepted.
trans-unit.target: Huuliza Have I Been Pwned kwa k-utambulisho fiche: ni herufi 5 tu za SHA-1 ya nywila zinazotoka kwenye duka, kamwe si nywila yenyewe. Huduma isipojibu ndani ya sekunde 3, nywila hukubaliwa.
